CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

2. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   C. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

4. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.
   B. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   D. Damage equipment used for Weaving.

5. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.
   D. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

10. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.

11. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

12. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
